# eSpeak NG 1.52.0

Bundled unmodified from the official Windows MSI at https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng/releases/tag/1.52.0.
Used as an independent command-line speech generator for Russian dictionary playback. Its voice is robotic and is supplementary pronunciation guidance rather than a native-speaker reference recording.

eSpeak NG is distributed under GNU GPL version 3 or later. See COPYING and the exact corresponding upstream source archive source-1.52.0.zip bundled in this directory. Copyright belongs to the eSpeak/eSpeak NG contributors; see the upstream source and COPYING for notices and build instructions. The executable and its required data and DLL files have not been modified. Glossix calls the executable as a separate process and consumes its WAV output; it does not link the library into its application code.
